description: A simple bar chart: two to seven labelled bars that grow from zero while their values count up. Highlight the bars that make your point.

title.description: Say what the chart shows, like a headline

unit.description: Shown after every value, like % or ms or k

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point (0 to 2)

value.description: Zero or more; bars are drawn to scale with the largest

highlight.description: Draws this bar in the aurora colours

note.description: Where the numbers come from, or how to read them
